paragraphs.text: Voyager-style prompt library, formula copy and conversation folders for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-prompt-library

**A Voyager-style workspace inside DeepSeek Harness** — prompt library, click-to-copy formulas and
c
onversation folders, as one native DSH plugin.

Gemini Voyager is a browser extension. This project
rebuilds its portable surfaces on DSH's own plug

in API, so they live in the app itself: no extension,
no separate window, no browser.
English | 中文
Full 33-second demo: dsh-prompt-library-demo.mp4
## Features
### Prompt library — the floating ball

| Floating ball | 46px, draggable, remembers its position, click to open |
| Panel | 440px, anchored

above the ball, clamped to the viewport, draggable header, position lock |
| Search | filters on na

me, body and tags as you type |
| Filters | All / Pinned / Recent, plus multi-select tag filters (AN

D) |
| Views | Compact (default) and comfortable |
| Ordering | pinned group with a divider; drag th

e grip to reorder, or focus it and press ↑/↓ |
| Preview | hover a row for 250ms to see the full mar

}` placeholders open a fill card; `\{{` escapes |
| Markdown | fences, headings, lists, quotes, rule

s, bold, inline code, links |
| Transfer | import/export in Voyager's own format (`gemini-voyager.pr

ompts.v1`) |
| Extras | Chinese/English UI, click-to-insert or click-to-copy |
### Quote reply

Select text anywhere in a conversation; a small toolbar appears. **引用** appends the selection to
the

composer as a Markdown block quote — one `>` per line, with a blank line first, through DSH's own
d
raft API. It never simulates a keypress, so it cannot send your draft by accident.
### Formula copy — click a formula
Hover a rendered formula and it highlights; click it and the LaTeX lands on your clipboard.

- Detection: `[data-math]` → `ms-katex` → `.katex` / `.katex-display` → `.math-inline`
- Source: `da

ta-math` → `data-math-source` → KaTeX's `annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"]`
- Formats (footer

switch): `$…$`, bare LaTeX, **MathML for Word**, `$$…$$` for Notion
- Inline formulas get `$…$`, di
splay formulas get `$$…$$`
### Conversation folders — a sidebar panel
An icon in the DSH sidebar rail opens a folder page:

- Sessions come from DSH's own catalog (`ctx.sessions.list`), subagent children filtered out
- Chips

: All / Unfiled / your folders, each with a count
- **Drag a session onto a folder** to file it; the

chip highlights as a target
- Double-click a folder (or ✎) to rename inline
- ✕ asks once before de

leting; deleting a folder unfiles its sessions and never deletes one
- Search sessions by title; row
s show which folder they belong to and whether they are running
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer (Desktop or `dsh web`)
- Node.js 20+ on the host

From GitHub (recommended):

Then reload the app window. A plugin installed for the first time may only show up after a
**full ap

p restart**: DSH composes the client bundle graph at boot, so a new entry is not always
picked up by

a page refresh alone. Use `--profile web` instead of `desktop` for a `dsh web`
profile.
From a local clone (for development):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
With a `link:` install, keep the directory where it is — a missing target is a load error at boot.
Uninstall:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Your data stays in `~/.dsh` (see below); delete those files to start clean.
## Where your data lives
| File | Contents |

| `~/.dsh/prompt-library.json` | the prompt library (Voyager's `PromptItem` shape) |
| `~/.dsh/sessi

on-folders.json` | folders plus one folder id per session id |
| `~/.dsh/prompt-library-debug.log` |
diagnostics for bug reports; safe to delete any time |
Nothing leaves your machine. There is no telemetry, no network call and no account.
## How it works
A DSH plugin has two halves, and this one ships both without a build step:
| Path | Half | Role |
| `lib/index.js` | host (Node) | owns the two JSON stores; serves 13 routes under `/dsh-prompts/api/

*` |
| `client/client.js` | browser | registers four slots: `shell.overlay`, `conversation.input.doc

k`, `sidebar.panellist`, `main` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch | inserts the entry into the p
rofile's layer stack |
The client bundle uses DSH's lazy-CJS loader format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`
ist/`, no build script, no `prepare` hook.
Writes go through DSH's own draft editor (`shell.draftEditor.appendDraft`), never through direct DOM
editing: DSH's composer re-renders from its own model, so a DOM write would be reconciled away.
## HTTP API

Exact routes, JSON, no-store. Reads are open on loopback; mutations must come from the DSH surface
(

loopback, the Desktop shell's `dsh-app://` origin, or `Origin: null`), and every other site is
refus

e Desktop shell's `dsh-app://` origin, or `Origin: null`), and every other site is
refused with 403.
| Route | Method | Body | Result |

| `/dsh-prompts/api/state` | GET | — | `{ items, count, bootId }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/add` | POST

| `{ name?, text, tags? }` | `{ item }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/update` | POST | `{ id, name?, text?,

tags?, pinnedAt? }` | `{ item }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/remove` | POST | `{ id }` | `{ ok }` |
| `/ds

h-prompts/api/reorder` | POST | `{ ids: string[] }` | `{ ids }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/import` | POST

| Voyager envelope, `{ items }`, or an array | `{ added, updated, skipped, total }` |
| `/dsh-promp

ts/api/export` | GET | — | Voyager envelope |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/folders/state` | GET | — | `{ fold

ers, assignments, bootId }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/folders/create` | POST | `{ name }` | `{ folder }`

|
| `/dsh-prompts/api/folders/rename` | POST | `{ id, name }` | `{ ok }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/fold

ers/remove` | POST | `{ id }` | `{ ok }` — unfiles its sessions |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/folders/assign

` | POST | `{ sessionId, folderId \| null }` | `{ ok }` |
| `/dsh-prompts/api/debug` | POST | `{ kin
d, detail }` | `{ ok }` |
